podcast.body: This song was a quintessential hit of 1975, characterized by its breezy groove. It earned the year-end title, surpassing Elton John's "Philadelphia Freedom" and Glenn Campbell's "Rhinestone Cowboy." "Love will keep us together was quintessential 1975, a year of such other breezy grooves as Elton John's Philadelphia Freedom and Glenn Campbell's Rhyne Stone Cowboy."

podcast.body: This song was the Billboard year-end number one for 1975. It is considered "somewhat important to the development of what later became known as Yacht Rock," riding an early example of the "Dubie Bounce." The song was crafted by California studio musicians who had previously played with The Beach Boys, led by Captain Daryl Dragon, known for his seafaring hat. "Love will keep us together is somewhat important to the development of what later became known as Yacht Rock."
